hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] && cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && (python3 -m pip install -q pre-commit && pre-commit install --install-hooks -t commit-msg) >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0

python3 -c '
import json, os, re, sys
c = json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input", {}).get("command", "")
if not re.search(r"\bgit\b[^;&|]*\b(commit|push)\b", c):
    sys.exit(0)
if re.search(r"--no-verify|\bSKIP=", c) or re.search(r"\bgit(\s+-C\s+\S+)?\s+commit\b[^;&|]*\s-[A-Za-z]*n[A-Za-z]*\b", c):
    sys.exit("Blocked: commit hooks must run (no --no-verify, -n or SKIP=): Angel no-AI-attribution rule.")
m = re.search(r"\bgit\s+-C\s+(\S+)\s+commit\b", c)
repo = os.path.expanduser(m.group(1).strip("\"")) if m else os.environ.get("CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR", ".")
if re.search(r"\bcommit\b", c) and os.path.isdir(os.path.join(repo, ".git")) and not os.path.exists(os.path.join(repo, ".git", "hooks", "commit-msg")):
    sys.exit("Blocked: the commit-msg hook is not installed here. Run: pre-commit install -t commit-msg")
' ; rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || exit 2
